categories_thin: Land surveying: still effectively one in-township survey firm (William M. Doran & Sons); CME Associates at 3759 US-1 also does survey work but is now rebranding as Artheon. Other surveyors surfaced are in New Brunswick, Piscataway, Sayreville and Matawan.

Environmental consulting / LSRP work: only Hesa Environmental, Panther Technologies, Hydros, Enviroscapes and Icon Engineering appeared in-township; the larger NJ remediation consultancies found are in Somerset, Princeton and further afield.

Property management: only a handful of genuinely in-township operators (Kent Management, Varma Properties, 11 Commerce Court, Metroplex Management, Tverdov Housing marketing the town from elsewhere). Most firms advertising 'South Brunswick property management' are based in New Brunswick, Hamilton, Trenton or East Brunswick.

Architecture and engineering remain dominated by small home-office practices and by firms with a Monmouth Junction mailing address but no published street address, so many entries carry 'Unknown' addresses.
Health, personal care, trades, retail, education and manufacturing (groups B, C and D) were out of scope for this zone per the brief and were not swept.
caveats: Chain, franchise and brand-affiliated entries were removed rather than carried forward: Allstate agents, Farmers, Edward Jones, J.P. Morgan Wealth Management, Century 21, RE/MAX, Better Homes & Gardens, Weichert Insurance, Criterium, Allegra and Jack Morton. Large firms over the size threshold (Jack Morton, Altran, Cuhaci & Peterson) were also removed.

Entries retired for wrong town or unsupported status after re-checking: Kendall Capital (Rockville, MD), Kline R.H. (Kingston), Strich Law Firm (now Monroe Township), Prevision Accountants (East Brunswick), Indik & McNamara (Metuchen), Martine Law (no township office documented), Johnson Jones Architects and George E. Jones AIA (Princeton office closed, moved to Newark), Megha K. Patel (North Brunswick), H. Scott Aalsberg (East Brunswick), Thomas V. Allen (South Plainfield/Princeton), Lafargue Law Firm (East Brunswick), George Basily CPA (East Brunswick), Barry J. Safeer CPA (East Brunswick), ASM Tax Office (Franklin Park).

Many entries rest on a single bulk directory (D&B, WhereOrg, AllBiz, AllPages, necomps, Cylex, Hubbiz, locationsnear). These are labelled accordingly and should be treated as a verify-before-outreach bucket, not confirmed operating businesses.
Several listings are individuals' names at residential streets in Kendall Park and Dayton; these are likely solo practitioners or home offices rather than firms with staff.

Some addresses sit on roads crossing the East Brunswick/South Brunswick line (Cranbury Rd, Ryders Ln, Georges Rd, US-130, Ridge Rd) and a few directories have already proven to mislabel township (Brier Hill Ct is East Brunswick). Town attribution should be confirmed for every single-directory entry before outreach.

Duplicate-looking clusters to merge at triage: Pavese-McCormick / King Risk Partners / Renaissance Alliance (3759 US-1, Suite 200); CME Associates / Icon Engineering (3759 US-1, Suite 100); Providence Abstract / Alternative Abstract; Rajan & Rajan / Rajan Legal PC; Marc D. Binder CPA / Binder Tobin CPAs; CSI Group / Master Tax Inc; Camacho & Camacho LLP / Camacho Capital Planning Advisors; Sharma Marcus & Associates / Terrance Marcus CPA Inc.

CME Associates' old domain now redirects to Artheon, formed by combining CME Associates, Churchill Engineers and Naik Group; the combined firm's headcount may approach the 500-staff ceiling even though the Monmouth Junction suite is a branch office.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Yelp, SuperPages, Cylex, AllBiz, AllPages, WhereOrg, D&B, Hubbiz and LocalityBiz frequently returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches from this network; those entries rest on search-engine snippets of the same pages rather than a page-level read.

Google Maps served a limited, non-paginated result view and Google web search returned a bot interstitial, so map-based cross-checks were shallow. Query URLs were removed as sources; any entry that had only a Maps query URL was either re-sourced to a real listing or dropped.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap was not usable from this network, so no OSM cross-check of the township business base was possible.
No township or county licensed-business list for South Brunswick was found; the township economic development pages are newsletters, not directories.

Trustek was dropped: trustek.com did not resolve/load on re-test, leaving no usable source. E. Martin Davidoff & Associates was dropped: the old site does not resolve, the live content is a blog, and the current practice (Davidoff Tax Law) publishes no Dayton address, so the Dayton office could not be confirmed.

Several name-only aggregation records (Jai Tax Services, Molnar Revilla CPA, Kiran CPA, Bednar CPA, we.health insurance consultant, Professional Provider Financial Group, Rudin Appraisals, Gallas Surveying Group) were removed because no address, phone or independent listing could be found for them.
Refuel Agency's own site now gives a Princeton (116 Village Blvd) headquarters rather than the Monmouth Junction address directories show; the township office could not be confirmed either way.
Pages requiring sign-in (LinkedIn profiles behind auth, ZoomInfo, PitchBook) were skipped, so headcount and revenue figures are limited to what public company pages displayed.
